offence_note: Impaired driving causing death and bodily harm; failing to stop
sentence_quote: I am satisfied that the appropriate global sentence is one of four years imprisonment comprised of a three and one-half year sentence for impaired driving causing death and a consecutive six month sentence for failing to stop at the scene of the accident.
note: Joint submission of 2 years less a day rejected.

offence_note: Sexual assault of child; invitation to sexual touching of child
sentence_quote: While an appropriate sentence may have been in the range of five to six years, as a consequence of his age, an appropriate and fit sentence is four years incarceration.
note: Geriatric unit recommendation discussed; outcome unclear. Mary Karlsson CSO rejected.

offence_note: Causing animals to be in distress (provincial animal cruelty act)
sentence_quote: the trial judge concluded that the sentence would be a fine of $2,000 per count and a lifetime order under s. 24(3) of the PCA Act.
note: Summary conviction appeal; lifetime animal ownership prohibition.

offence_note: Possession of child pornography (sexual abuse counts sent to new trial)
sentence_quote: I would allow the sentence appeal on count 4 and vary the sentence to time served.
note: Counts 1-3 convictions quashed, new trial; only count 4 sentence varied to time served.

sentence_quote: suspended the passing of sentence for two years and ordered that the probation order contain terms directing community service and continued counselling.
note: Crown appeal dismissed; probation length taken as two years.

offence_note: Aggravated assault, concealed weapon, breach of probation; dangerous offender
sentence_quote: Ms. Walker asks that the dangerous offender finding and indeterminate sentence be set aside and a new hearing ordered. For the reasons given, I would allow the appeal and grant that remedy.
note: Dangerous offender finding and indeterminate sentence set aside; new hearing ordered.

offence_note: Common assault and two counts assault causing bodily harm
sentence_quote: for a total of six months imprisonment. The sentence was to be served in the community, with a house arrest component for the six months.
note: Summary conviction appeal dismissed; conditional sentence followed by probation of unstated length.

offence_note: Assault and two breaches of probation
sentence_quote: the appeal is allowed and the sentence imposed following plea is set aside and a sentence of six months incarceration less a day is substituted.
note: Reduced from 183 days to avoid immigration consequences; probation and DNA assumed unchanged.

offence_note: Second degree murder, parole ineligibility fixed
sentence_quote: an appropriate period of parole ineligibility is twelve years.
note: Conviction reduced to second degree murder; court fixed parole ineligibility, running from September 1999.

offence_note: Homicide conviction by jury; type not shown
sentence_quote: With respect to the appeal from sentence, we can see no error in principle in the sentence imposed by the trial judge and cannot, therefore, interfere with that sentence.
note: Sentence not described in the endorsement.
